summary: One moved asset no longer holds back closing your vulnerabilities.

fixes.title: One unclear finding no longer blocks every close
fixes.text: When an asset moved to another CI, one unclear finding stopped every close in the run. Now only the CIs concerned are held, and the run's warning names them.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Database setup can now run during a pipeline run. Moving to new identity names now checks the moved rights completely.
